units.step: Isolate and verify the filter boundary
units.hazard: Pressure can return to the housing from connected pipework
units.cause: Closing the inlet alone leaves an outlet header, bypass or shared drain connected
units.consequence: Unexpected air or fluid release when opening the housing
units.control: Identify connected pressure paths, isolate the complete boundary and verify the housing is safely depressurized using the actual equipment procedure before opening
units.verification: Record the isolation boundary, verification method and checks for pressure returning
conditions: Confirm the actual filter model and all connected pressure paths

sources.section: Eight-stage JSA stages 2 and 3; failure mechanisms and scope exclusions

units.task: Asphalt cold milling and truck loading
units.hazard: A person may be struck or trapped between the truck and conveyor
units.cause: Uncoordinated movement, poor sight lines or entry into the vehicle gap
units.control: Stop discharge for the planned exchange, confirm agreed signals and safe signaller positions, and keep personnel out of the gap and movement path
units.verification: Confirm the shared stop signal, personnel locations, visibility and vehicle clearance before movement
conditions: Use the actual traffic-control plan and machine operating instructions

sources.section: Eight-stage JSA stages 5 and 6; hold and proceed decisions

units.step: Check ventilation and shielding gas arrangements
units.hazard: Welding exposure or oxygen depletion may remain despite little visible smoke
units.cause: Ineffective extraction or accumulation of shielding gas
units.control: Assess the actual atmosphere and exposure, provide effective extraction, and verify its position does not undermine the required shielding arrangement
units.verification: Check the air assessment, extraction position and shielding conditions; reassess if the hood moves
conditions: Confirm the actual welding procedure, equipment and work area
